kpis.name_fr: Coût des ventes en pourcentage des ventes de produits
kpis.name_en: Cost of sales as a percentage of net product sales
kpis.signal: 48 % des ventes de produits en 2025 (47 % en 2024): inclut 291 M $ de depreciations de stocks et 93 M $ de capacite de fabrication inutilisee
kpis.notes: Verbatim 10-K FY2025 (20 fev 2026): 'Our cost of sales was $868 million, or 48% of our net product sales, in 2025 ... Our cost of sales was $1.5 billion, or 47% of our net product sales, in 2024.'

kpis.name_en: Net cash used in operating activities
kpis.signal: Consommation ramenee a 1,9 Md $ en 2025, en baisse de 38 % vs 2024: perte nette de 2,8 Mds $ attenuee par les ajustements hors tresorerie
kpis.notes: Verbatim 10-K FY2025: 'Net cash used by operating activities in 2025 was $1.9 billion' et 'Net cash used by operating activities decreased by $1.1 billion, or 38%, in 2025 compared to 2024' (2024 = 3,0 Mds $ derive: 1,9 + 1,1).

kpis.signal: Trois vaccins respiratoires commercialises fin 2025: Spikevax et mNEXSPIKE (COVID) et mRESVIA (RSV)
kpis.notes: Verbatim 10-K FY2025: 'We have three commercial respiratory vaccines-Spikevax and mNEXSPIKE (our COVID vaccines) and mRESVIA (our RSV vaccine...)'. Historique: 1 produit (Spikevax) jusqu'en 2023, +mRESVIA (approuve mai 2024) = 2 en 2024, +mNEXSPIKE (approuve 2025) = 3 en 2025.
